scope: Only OpponentPresentation CSS coordinate conversion. Rules, GameScene, ShopScene, timings and save format unchanged.

rejectedCaptureAttempts.first-capture-timeout: Geometry correct; some screenshots/late skip missed the short cue. No complete pass claimed.
rejectedCaptureAttempts.second-capture-timeout: Added live-cue check rejected captures after cue had expired.
rejectedCaptureAttempts.debugger-capture-aborted: Debugger-paused capture did not complete; task browser processes terminated. No pass.
rejectedCaptureAttempts.capture-probe: Late virtual-time pause found no cue and failed.
rejectedCaptureAttempts.capture-probe-early: DOM geometry report passed but root rejected image because cue was absent.
rejectedCaptureAttempts.capture-settled-probe: Root rejected clipped screenshot without cue despite geometry data.
rejectedCaptureAttempts.live-extra-skip-timeout: High-DPR menu skip did not finish in the short cue; not accepted.
rejectedCaptureAttempts.normal-live-sampling-failure: Normal-motion sampling timed out on one cue; not accepted.
rejectedCaptureAttempts.resize-capture-sampling-failure: Duplicate pre-resize sampling missed a cue; failed record retained.

screenshotPixels: CSS viewport dimensions, with page DPR/backing recorded separately. No clip; page DPR and cue identity preserved.
limits: Low-dynamic software geometry only; screenshot virtual time is paused. No ordinary-motion duration/readability, high-DPR menu skip, physical device or whole-game acceptance.
